reasoning_content: Let me do a real end-to-end run. Start a local HTTP server serving tests/data, and run the script with --url pointing to catalog.ttl. Note the script may need my_api_key file. Let me run a real end-to-end.

action.command: cd /workspace && (cd tests/data && python3 -m http.server 8123 >/tmp/httpd.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 1.5 && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "server HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8123/catalog.ttl && poetry run python dcat_catalog_check.py --url http://localhost:8123/catalog.ttl > /tmp/e2e.jsonl 2>/tmp/e2e.err; echo "e2e exit=$?"; echo "lines=$(wc -l < /tmp/e2e.jsonl)"; echo "--- first 3 records ---"; head -3 /tmp/e2e.jsonl; echo "--- stderr tail ---"; tail -5 /tmp/e2e.err
